item.title: Vision Media Now Supports Samsung SmartTV Apps
item.description: We’re excited to announce that Vision Media now supports secure screeners on Samsung Smart TVs. This addition enhances your ability to stream content seamlessly and securely. We also continue to support Roku, iOS, and Apple TV, offering even more flexibility across a range of popular devices. Enjoy a high-quality viewing experience with the privacy and protection you expect from Vision Media. Stay tuned for more updates. item.title: Vision Media powers the Cindependent Virtual Film Festival
item.description: We’re excited to welcome the Cindependent Film Festival to the Vision streaming platform. Cincinnati’s home for independent filmmaking, Cindependent brings three days of shorts and features, live script readings, masterclasses, and community networking. Key dates:• Welcome Party — Sep 17• Festival — Sep 18–20 at Memorial Hall• Awards Brunch — Sep 21 Vision will power secure online screeners and the Virtual Festival Pass.
